name: cloud-armor-crs-rule-upgrader
description: >- Upgrades Google Cloud Armor security policies from OWASP CRS 3.0 and 3.3 to OWASP CRS 4.22. Preserves signature opt-in and opt-out lists, translates evaluatePreconfiguredExpr to native evaluatePreconfiguredWaf dictionary parameters, remaps signature IDs to v042200, drops retired signature IDs, and updates structured preconfiguredWafConfig fine-tuning exclusions. Evaluates operational risk (High Breaking Change, Medium Attention Required, Low Clean Upgrade) including Method Enforcement breakin
author: google
